dialogue.origin: ロールプレイをよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you in advance for participating in this role-play.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Likewise, thank you.

dialogue.origin: きょうはお越し頂きありがとうございます。年代と性別をお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming today. Could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 16才　女
dialogue.content: 16, female.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。きょうはどんな相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 学校に行きたくなくて…
dialogue.content: I don’t want to go to school...

dialogue.origin: 今は夏休みですけどもうすぐ新学期が始まると思うと憂鬱になりますね。いつから学校に行きたくない気持ちですか？
dialogue.content: I see. It's summer vacation now, but it must be depressing to think about the new semester starting soon. How long have you been feeling like you don't want to go to school?

dialogue.origin: 春からです
dialogue.content: Since spring.

dialogue.origin: そんなに長く、行きたくない気持ちなのですね。なにかそのころ思いあたる事などありますか？
dialogue.content: You’ve been feeling that way for quite a while. Is there anything from around that time that comes to mind?

dialogue.origin: 無理して進学校に進んだので、中学の頃の友達とは、別の高校になりました
dialogue.content: I pushed myself to go to an academic high school, so I ended up at a different high school than my friends from middle school.

dialogue.origin: 友達もできず、ずっと一人で居ます
dialogue.content: I haven't been able to make any friends, and I'm always alone.

dialogue.origin: 仲の良かった友達と離れてしまい淋しいですね。進学校は友達もできずにいて勉強は身にはいりますか？
dialogue.content: It must be lonely being separated from your close friends. And without making new friends at your new school, are you able to focus on your studies?

dialogue.origin: 授業は受けてるけど、成績はよくありません。
dialogue.content: I attend classes, but my grades aren’t good.

dialogue.origin: 無理して進学校にして失敗しました
dialogue.content: I made a mistake by pushing myself to go to this academic high school.

dialogue.origin: ついて行けそうもないし、学校辞めたくなります
dialogue.content: I don’t think I can keep up, and I feel like quitting school.

dialogue.origin: 勉強をやる気も起きないないのですね。でも、がんばって学校へは１学期に行っていたのですね。
dialogue.content: So you don't feel motivated to study. But you still managed to go to school during the first semester, didn't you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。辞めたくなる気持ちになりますよね。ご両親は行きたくない気持ちを知っていて何か言っていますか？
dialogue.content: I see. It's understandable that you'd feel like quitting. Do your parents know you don't want to go to school, and have they said anything?

dialogue.origin: 特に話はしていません
dialogue.content: I haven’t really talked to them about it.

dialogue.origin: それではあなたの気持ちに気がついていないようですね。それは悲しい気持ちを抱えていることでしょう。
dialogue.content: So it seems they aren't aware of how you're feeling. You must be carrying a lot of sadness.

dialogue.origin: はい。どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: Yes. What should I do?

dialogue.origin: あなたは今の学校へは希望していましたか？
dialogue.content: Did you originally want to go to this school?

dialogue.origin: 一緒に考えていけたらいいですね。
dialogue.content: I hope we can think this through together.

dialogue.origin: お願いします。一応、希望してました
dialogue.content: Yes, please. I did want to go here, I suppose.

dialogue.origin: 希望していたのですね、それでは春の頃は気持ちは嬉しい気持ちでいっぱいでしたでしょう。
dialogue.content: So you did want to go there. You must have been very happy back in the spring, then.

dialogue.origin: そうでもないです
dialogue.content: Not really.

dialogue.origin: なにかありましたか？それともいままでのお友達がいなくてやっぱりさみしかったですか？
dialogue.content: Did something specific happen? Or was it that you felt lonely without your old friends after all?

dialogue.origin: 特にやりたいことがあったわけでもないので、ちょっとレベルの高い方を選んだ方がいいのかな　と思ったくらいです
dialogue.content: It’s not that I had anything I especially wanted to do; I just thought maybe choosing a school with a slightly higher academic level would be better.

dialogue.origin: レベルの高い高校を選んで合格できたのですから、そこは自信を持っていいと思いますよ。
dialogue.content: But you chose a high-level high school and were able to get in, so I think you can be confident about that.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: だけど今は自信を持てないのですね。部活は中学では何かしていました？高校でも部活をしていますか？
dialogue.content: But right now, you can't feel that confidence, can you? Did you participate in any clubs in middle school? Are you in any in high school?

dialogue.origin: 中学では、バトミントン。今は何もしていません
dialogue.content: I played badminton in middle school. I’m not doing anything now.

dialogue.origin: バトミントンをされていたのですね。賞など頂いたり、部長の経験などあったでしょう？
dialogue.content: So you played badminton. Did you ever win any awards or have experience as a team captain?

dialogue.origin: 去年は大した練習もできなかったし、成績は残せていません。リーダー経験もありません
dialogue.content: We couldn't practice much last year, so I didn't achieve any notable results. I don't have any leadership experience either.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。それでは中学の頃のお友達が懐かしくかんじたりおしゃべりしたい気持ちをがまんしてるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. In that case, are you perhaps feeling nostalgic for your middle school friends and holding back the desire to talk with them?

dialogue.origin: ひとりで過ごしているのは寂しいです
dialogue.content: It's lonely spending my time by myself.

dialogue.origin: 夏休みが終わるかと思うと、、、つらいです
dialogue.content: When I think about summer vacation ending... it's painful.

dialogue.origin: ですよね。今は仲の良い友達も少ないようですし、一人でいるのは辛いですね。
dialogue.content: I understand. It sounds like you don’t have many close friends right now, and being alone is painful.

dialogue.origin: はい・・・学校に行きたくないです
dialogue.content: Yes... I don’t want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: 夏休みが終わる時の気持ちは嫌なものですから。あなたは中学のお友達とは今はラインなど連絡とりますか？中学の友達とは楽しくお話しできるでしょう？
dialogue.content: That feeling when summer vacation is about to end is never a pleasant one. Do you keep in touch with your middle school friends on an app like LINE? I bet you can enjoy talking with them, right?

dialogue.origin: 中学の頃の友達とはLINEはしてます
dialogue.content: I do chat on LINE with my friends from middle school.

dialogue.origin: 高校の友達とはしている人はいないのかな？仲の良い友達ができると学校も楽しくなるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: Is there anyone among your high school friends you chat with? If you make some close friends, school might become more enjoyable.

dialogue.origin: もうグループができていて、仲間には入りづらいです
dialogue.content: Groups have already formed, and it’s hard to join in.

dialogue.origin: グループは入りにくいですね。すごくさみしくて何か元気でませんよね。
dialogue.content: It is hard to break into established groups. It must feel very lonely and drain your energy, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい・・・どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: Yes... what should I do?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。あなたは進学校へ合格できた時は嬉しかったですけど束の間でお友達が出来ずに淋しい思いをされていますね。でもがんばって学校へは通っていたのですからそこは自分でも褒めてくだいね。
dialogue.content: I see. You were happy when you got into the academic high school, but that feeling was short-lived, and you’ve been feeling lonely without making friends. Even so, you’ve kept going to school—please give yourself credit for that.

dialogue.origin: はい。でも苦しいです
dialogue.content: Yes. But it's still painful.

dialogue.origin: きっと頑張り屋さんで親ごさんにも心配をかけたくないのでしょう。悲しい気持ちを抱えているのでしょう。
dialogue.content: You must be a hard worker, and you probably don't want to worry your parents. You must be holding onto a lot of sadness.

dialogue.origin: だれか周りに自分の気持ちを少しでも話せる人がいるといいですね。
dialogue.content: It would be good if there was someone around you could share your feelings with, even just a little.

dialogue.origin: 気持が楽になるかもしれませんから。ちょっと勇気が必要かもしれませんがどうでしょう？
dialogue.content: It might make you feel lighter. It may take a bit of courage, but what do you think?

dialogue.origin: 誰にも話せなくてここに来ました
dialogue.content: I couldn’t talk to anyone, so I came here.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。中学の友達には自分の気持ちを話せますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Are you able to talk about your feelings with your middle school friends?

dialogue.origin: 学校でのことは話しても解決できないので、そんな話はしません
dialogue.content: Talking about what's happening at school won't solve anything, so I don't bring it up.

dialogue.origin: それでは悲しみも大きく感じますね。自然のあるところは好きですか？森のにおいや水の流れる音など感じてくださいね。
dialogue.content: Then the sadness must feel even heavier. Do you like being in nature? Try to take in the scent of the forest or the sound of flowing water.

dialogue.origin: きっと気持ちも和らぐかもしれませんから。あなたはきっと周りの人の気使いが出来る人かもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: It might help soften your feelings. You may very well be someone who is considerate of those around you.

dialogue.origin: そんな優しいあなたが周りの人達とも自然な流れで少しお話しできるといいですね。
dialogue.content: It would be great if a kind person like you could naturally start talking a little with the people around you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お友達ができると学校も楽しくなるでしょうから、勉強の意欲もででくるかもしれまでんね。進学校へ合格できたあなただから勉強も意欲がでれば大丈夫になることを望んでいます。
dialogue.content: If you make friends, school will likely become more enjoyable, and your motivation to study may come back as well. Since you were able to get into an academic high school, I hope that when your motivation returns, you’ll be able to manage your studies.

dialogue.origin: きょうはここまでですがまた話したい事ありましたら来て相談してくださいね。
dialogue.content: That's all for today, but if there's anything else you want to talk about, please come back and see me.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございます。きょうは終了いたします。相談役お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. We will conclude for today. Thank you for your hard work in the client role.

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございました。お疲れさまでした！）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much. Good work today!)
